description: Execute the move/mark actions in the triage rules file against a mailbox. Returns a plan grouped by sender and changes NOTHING unless confirm=true (or, where the policy sets this tool to confirm, the confirmToken a first call returns): review the plan first. Messages newer than minAgeDays are never touched.

confirm.description: Set true to actually move/mark. Omitted or false returns the plan only.

confirmToken.description: Only after a confirmation_required error: the confirmToken it returned, with the same arguments, to carry out the call.

dryRun.description: Check the call and report what it would do, without doing it.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A repeat of this key with the same arguments within 24 hours returns the first result with replayed=true and does nothing.

maxActions.description: Cap on messages actuated per run (default: 200). Oldest first.

minAgeDays.description: Never touch messages newer than this many days (default: 14).

scanLimit.description: Messages to enumerate from the mailbox (default: 500).
